notes: Three sheets form one delivery: Material supplies /sku and /product_name, Price supplies /price and /currency keyed by material code, Stock supplies /inventory entries keyed by material code plus warehouse.
Material code is shown in a zero-padded form (e.g. '000001'); it should be emitted as text so leading zeros survive into /sku.
Stock contains exactly two rows per material, one for BKK and one for CNX; both warehouses must be preserved and must not be summed together into a single figure.
Currency is explicit in the source as THB for every row, so no currency assumption or question is required.
The selling price column is explicitly labelled as a selling price; no VAT or cost adjustments should be applied to it.
